The Delta State Police Command says it will prosecute the seven suspects arrested over the killing of a staff member of the Benin Electricity Distribution Company during a power disconnection exercise in Umunede, Ika North-East Local Government Area of the state. The command’s Public Relations Officer, Bright Edafe, disclosed this in a statement on Thursday, saying the Umunede Divisional Police Headquarters received a report of the attack at about 1.15pm on November 16. He noted that the victim reportedly sustained multiple stab wounds after BEDC personnel were attacked by suspected cultists at Ileje Quarters on Monday. He stated, “Upon receipt of the report, detectives were mobilised to the scene, and the victim, who sustained multiple stab wounds, was rushed to the General Hospital, Umunede, where he was confirmed dead.” Edafe added that preliminary investigations led to the arrest of five suspects: Emmanuel Chinonso, 30; Gift Francis, 24; Jerry Nusi, 20; Kelvin Ifeanyi, 19; and Emmanuel Chinaza, 24. He continued, “The manhunt to apprehend other suspects connected with the incident is ongoing.” Edafe noted that the Commissioner of Police, Delta State, Samuel Erale, condemned the killing and extended his condolences to the victim’s family and the management and staff of BEDC. The statement quoted Erale as expressing concern over recurring attacks on BEDC personnel and warning that “grievances must be addressed through lawful channels”.
